name: Professional Computer Technology Limited
summary: Professional Computer Technology Limited operates within the Chinese market, focusing on the development, manufacturing, quality control, and distribution of electronic products and components for computers. The company's offerings encompass a range of items, including active and passive electronic parts, core and application-specific computer software, and various business-to-business (B2B) components. These products are marketed under its own brands: PCT, NOR, and Flash. The firm was established in 1981 and maintains its corporate headquarters in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
